queries.title: Search queries
queries.description: One or more search terms. Supports Google News operators like "exact phrase", site:bbc.com, when:7d, before:2026-01-01.

rssUrls.title: Custom Google News RSS URLs
rssUrls.description: Optional: topic/section/publication feeds from news.google.com/rss/... (added to the queries).

excludeWords.title: Exclude words
excludeWords.description: Words or phrases to exclude, applied to every query (e.g. "iphone" drops articles mentioning it). Equivalent to typing -word yourself, just easier to manage as a list. Does not apply to rssUrls, since those are fixed feed URLs, not search terms.

language.title: Language (hl)
language.description: e.g. en-US, en-GB, de, fr, es, pt-BR, ar, ja

country.title: Country (gl)
country.description: Two-letter country code, e.g. US, GB, DE, IN, EG

maxItemsPerQuery.title: Max articles per query
maxItemsPerQuery.description: Google returns up to 100 per feed.

decodeUrls.title: Resolve real article URLs
decodeUrls.description: Google News links are encoded redirects. When on, each link is decoded to the publisher's URL (one extra request per article).

fetchArticleBody.title: Extract full article text
fetchArticleBody.description: Open each publisher page and extract the full article body, author, image, keywords and section (JSON-LD first, HTML paragraphs as fallback). Adds one request per article and is slower; paywalled/blocked articles are still returned with articleFetchStatus explaining why the text is missing.

articleBodyMaxChars.title: Max article body length
articleBodyMaxChars.description: Truncate articleBody to this many characters (articleBodyTruncated tells you when it happened). Only used when 'Extract full article text' is on.
